title: VHS Echoes
logline: In a desolate 1980s arcade town, a desperate detective on a monochrome VHS quest uncovers the mysteries of parallel dimensions while searching for his lost sibling.
synopsis: In a bleak and isolated retro 1980s arcade town, Detective Jack Hawkins is obsessed with finding his missing sister. As he navigates the eerie streets filled with flickering neon signs and nostalgic video games, he discovers hidden passages leading to parallel worlds. Each dimension holds clues that bring them closer but also deeper into an enigma. Jack's journey becomes a race against time as he uncovers a cosmic conspiracy threatening reality itself. With each macro close-up revealing intricate textures and high-contrast visuals, Jack's search takes on epic proportions, blending the past with the unknown.

characters.name: Detective Jack Hawkins
characters.description: A driven and haunted detective in his mid-30s, haunted by memories of his lost sister. His desperate search for her drives him to explore the town's hidden dimensions, facing challenges that test both his wits and his sanity.

characters.name: Mia
characters.description: Jack's estranged sister who appears in different dimensions as a symbol of his past. She guides Jack through the parallel worlds, revealing secrets about their family history and the cosmic threat that threatens all realities.

characters.name: The Enigma
characters.description: A malevolent force or entity that exists across multiple dimensions, seeking to consume reality. The Enigma drives Jack's desperation and forces him to uncover the truth about his past and the fate of his sister.
